_note: Harness overlay for OTClient Redemption (opentibiabr/otclient). Applied by setup_client.py to a COPY of the installed client, never to the install. Each edit must match exactly once (line endings normalised), so upstream drift fails loudly instead of silently producing a different client.

edits.why: no network asset installer (dudantas/tibia-client); assets come from the local install
edits.replace: clientAssets = false, -- HARNESS: network asset installer disabled (setup_client.py)

edits.why: per-instance identity: each instance (p1, c1, ...) gets its own write dir %APPDATA%/otc-harness/otch-<name>/, log and settings
game_bot dials an external BotServer (ws://arm.skalski.pro:8000) and must never load in the harness

audio OFF from the first frame: persisted per instance before client_options reads it (enableAudio / enableMusicSound / musicSoundVolume) and the sound manager disabled before modules/client starts the login music
edits.replace:
g_modules.ensureModuleLoaded('corelib')
-- HARNESS: audio OFF (no music, no sound effects) before any module can play; client_options
-- then loads these values instead of its defaults. harness_ctl re-asserts it at runtime.
g_settings.set('enableAudio', false)
g_settings.set('enableMusicSound', false)
g_settings.set('musicSoundVolume', 0)
if g_sounds then g_sounds.setAudioEnabled(false) end
